report.text:
# Go immediate additive record consumption

Baseline: official concat-fold README, Go 37 **9.187287572 ms**, C 37 **8.777346938669927 ms**. Compiler HEAD `5a87a36a4a497b9a4c0d36448fc0e15d3af94e73` is clean after an external commit; all 212 measured source/binary hashes match the preceding publication. All 2,508 repository files, README, todo and executables are frozen. The 742 protected benchmark/reference files and 269 FFI/library files retain their hashes. No benchmark, harness, reference or runtime changes; no commit/push by this campaign.

The preceding three-process diagnostic found medium 16.06→8.037 ns and large 30.11→10.68 ns, with 2,016 bounded copied-action checks. Those diagnostic numbers are separate from the actual-build measurements below.

RecordConsumer derives temporary intramodule plans from certified additive recurrences. It recognizes immediate, complete IntAdd consumers of the updated and original records. For counts 1..Int32Max and a fully checked current shape, it reads fields once and computes the equivalent scalar result modulo 32. Unknown, captured, partial, contradictory, recursive or nonmatching forms retain the original complete expression. Effects and inputs are evaluated in their original order; no input mutation, ownership inference, public ABI or persistent cache descriptor is introduced.

Six files change: three compiler modules and three tests/fixture files. The final snapshot contains 2,512 files and 213 compiler source/binary hashes. Bootstrap validates 566 TAST modules/351,983 types; stages are 3.9s JS,51.8s frontend,204.4s generation,53.6s Go. The existing PrivateSTRegions warning is unchanged. To restore 8.30GiB free, three old campaign-owned bootstrap directories were compressed, verified entry-by-entry and then removed only from temporary storage;22,143 entries remain recoverable in separately hashed tar.gz archives. Sources, modules and proofs are preserved.

## Validation

Four unit entries include 11,340 generated Go comparisons. Source E2E passes 44 observations in Release and Dev on isolated JS and final main native hosts; a delta 1→2 transition keeps ABI and gives identical warm/clean Release results. Native hashes and 12 phase logs are retained.

Actual saved public getters receive 672 dynamic medium/large variants through Apply, the official FFI callback adaptation and forced fallback:2,016 observations per build, with one preparation and two invocation opaque calls. Three replays preserve captured inputs and immutability. There are 864 independent modulo 32 oracle results and 1,152 malformed-record panics. The eight bounded counts exclude−1 and nonzero values with low 32 bits zero, whose original fallback may run billions of iterations; native-wide inputs do not extend the C comparison domain.

Inputs and all results agree before/after. Exactly 576 panic rows differ only in process addresses: normalization replaces solely `(?<=UnsafePtr:)0x[0-9a-f]+`; every other character agrees. Raw outputs remain archived. Before stderr contains one Go dependency-download message; after stderr is empty. Separate actual opaque-boundary alias proofs pass 108 dictionary/raw-map plus 36 compact-small observations per build, including external mutation. Historical executions are not recounted.

Generated core 633/633 sections are identical. Exactly 3/683 library sections change: the three saved record actions. Each adds only a guarded scalar branch after the opaque calls; the complete original body remains byte-identical. Preparation, workers, registrations, harness, headers, runtime, FFI and initialization are unchanged. Post-timing allocation checks verify 1,002 returns per actual case/build: all three remain 0 allocations.

## Measurements

| Case | Paired before (ns) | After (ns) | Change | Go/C after |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| record/set-small-1000 | 9.357 | 8.506 | -9.09% | 7.572× |
| record/set-medium-1000 | 19.381 | 9.768 | -49.60% | 8.702× |
| record/set-large-1000 | 33.669 | 12.064 | -64.17% | 8.897× |

| Indicator | Official baseline | Paired before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Total | 1.046704× | 1.089758× | 1.090567× |
| Arithmetic μ | 5.001127× | 5.219632× | 4.537797× |
| Median Q₂ | 4.077025× | 4.279354× | 4.338441× |
| Geometric G | 2.290405× | 2.393997× | 2.285193× |

Go 37 is 9.565181858→9.572284360ms: total **+0.074%**, arithmetic **-13.063%**, median **+1.381%**, geometric **-4.545%**. All primary values are retained. The three targets save 0.032069µs; unchanged RBTree moves 9467.000→9474.083µs (+7.083µs), so no overall elapsed-time gain is claimed. Against the official README, total/μ/Q₂/G change **+4.191%/-9.265%/+6.412%/-0.228%**; these historical movements are distinct from paired gains. No individual primary increase exceeds 5%, so no extra regression timing is run.

The same 37 C pairs use App 14+AppAll 23 medians from 12 processes in AB/BA/AB order. Each process uses three global/local warm-ups, calibrated≥10ms batches and≥10 batches; reported times are medians of three process minima. Release, GOGC 800, default GOMAXPROCS, noPGO; all other builds/tests/profiles/reviews stop during timing. Host isolation is not claimed. All 306 outputs and source guards pass; C/JS are not remeasured.

Only existing Go Release README cells are updated. [The JSON archive](2026-11-27-go-record-consumer.json) retains all samples, transfers, proofs, source snapshots and logs; working files remain under `var/benchmark/go-record-consumer-20261127`.

+-- Ephemeral consumers reuse this complete recurrence proof. No imported ABI
+-- or usage count establishes the meaning of an arbitrary record function.
+flatAdditive :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe { keys :: Array String, deltas :: Array Int, counterFirst :: Boolean }
+flatAdditive self params result body = do
+  recurrence <- recognize self params result body
+  fields <- case result of
+    TypeRecord fields | Array.all (\(Tuple _ ty) -> ty == TypeInt64) fields -> Just fields
+    _ -> Nothing
+  changes <- case recurrence.changes of
+    Fields _ changes | not (Array.null changes) -> Just changes
+    _ -> Nothing
+  deltas <- traverse (\(Tuple _ change) -> case change of
+    Add (Constant delta) -> Just delta
+    _ -> Nothing) changes
+  pure { keys: map fst fields, deltas, counterFirst: case params of
+    [ Tuple _ TypeInt64, _ ] -> true
+    _ -> false }

+additiveTotal counter deltas = foldl (GoBinOp "+") (GoInt 0)

+make seed = { alpha: seed, beta: seed + 1, delta: seed + 2, gamma: seed + 3, iota: seed + 4, omega: seed + 5, theta: seed + 6, zeta: seed + 7 }

+total row = row.alpha + row.beta + row.delta + row.gamma + row.iota + row.omega + row.theta + row.zeta

+increase :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+increase 0 row = row

+decrease :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+decrease 0 row = row
+decrease remaining row = decrease (remaining - 1) (row { beta = row.beta - 1 })

+normalize :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+normalize 0 row = row
+normalize remaining row = normalize (remaining - 1) (row { gamma = row.gamma + 0 })
+
+multiple :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+multiple 0 row = row
+multiple remaining row = multiple (remaining - 1) (row { delta = row.delta + 3, zeta = row.zeta - 2 })

+consume :: Int -> Ref.Ref Snapshot -> Effect Int
+consume count reference = do
+  original <- Ref.read reference
+  let changed = increase count original
+  pure (total changed + total original)

+consumeDown count reference = do

+  let changed = decrease count original
+  pure (total changed + total original)

+withUnknown :: Int -> Ref.Ref Snapshot -> Effect Int
+withUnknown count reference = do

+withExtraUse count reference = do
+  original <- Ref.read reference
+  let changed = increase count original
+  pure [ total changed + total original, changed.theta ]

+withInterveningEffect :: Int -> Ref.Ref Snapshot -> Effect Int
+withInterveningEffect count reference = do
+  original <- Ref.read reference

  ( translate
  , translateWithFunctions
  , PreparedModule
  , prepareModule
  , workerInputs

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(PrimEffect, PrimOp, Branch, Fail, CtorDef, CtorSaturated, Lit, UncurriedAbs, Abs, Update, Accessor, LetRec, Let, EffectDefer, EffectPure, EffectBind, UncurriedEffectAbs, UncurriedEffectApp, UncurriedApp, App, Local, Var, Typed))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)

import Gopurs.ConstructorFold as ConstructorFold

import Gopurs.RefLoopRegions as RefLoopRegions
import Gopurs.DecoderSchemas (specializeDecoderSchemas)
import Gopurs.CallExprs as CallExprs
import Gopurs.FunctionExprs as FunctionExprs
import Gopurs.BindingExprs as BindingExprs
import Gopurs.ControlExprs as ControlExprs
import Gopurs.EffectExprs as EffectExprs
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.ImmediateEffects as ImmediateEffects
import Gopurs.TypedExprs as TypedExprs
import Gopurs.ModuleBindings as ModuleBindings
import Gopurs.ModuleDeclarations as ModuleDeclarations
import Gopurs.GoImports (collectImports)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, isEffectNode)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, childContext)

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata (CodePointFold.optimize (ClosedIndexedFolds.optimize inputMod)))
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize (RefLoopRegions.optimize progressions.module)
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    foldDescriptors = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      map (\(Tuple (Ident name) value) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (ClosedIndexedFolds.describe value)) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    codePointDescriptors = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      map (\(Tuple (Ident name) value) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (CodePointFold.describe value)) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    describedFunctions = Map.fromFoldable (map (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple name (info
      { arrayFold = if info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64 && info.arity == 1 then fromMaybe Nothing (Map.lookup name foldDescriptors) else Nothing
      , codePointFold = if info.fArgs == [ TypeString ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64 && info.arity == 1 then fromMaybe Nothing (Map.lookup name codePointDescriptors) else Nothing
      })) (Map.toUnfoldable preparedBindings.functions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo)))
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions describedFunctions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups = map (map RecordReadGroups.declaration)
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.guardedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.powerOfTwoModulo translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

-- Collapse pure countdown recurrences over immutable native records. The
-- complete update tree is proved before changing the number of iterations.
module Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops (wrap, hot) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), recordFieldName)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Literal(..), Prop(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

data Delta = Constant Int | Remainders Int
data Change = Keep | Fields GoType (Array (Tuple String Change)) | Add Delta

type Recurrence = { counter :: String, record :: String, changes :: Change }

wrap :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
wrap self params result body original = case recognize self params result body of
  Just recurrence ->
    let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
        record = GoVar (recurrence.record <> "_loop")
        admitted = GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp ">" counter (integer 0))
          (GoBinOp "<=" counter (integer top))
    in GoBlock [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoReturn (emit counter record recurrence.changes) ] [], original ]
  Nothing -> original

-- A small native wrapper can inline at its callers while the complete old
-- worker remains the cold fallback. Only one flat field and a cheap constant
-- delta are admitted; nested updates and larger expressions keep their layout.
-- The proof of the recurrence is shared with wrap, not reconstructed from Go.
hot :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
hot self params result body fallback = do
  recurrence <- recognize self params result body
  Tuple field delta <- case recurrence.changes of
    Fields _ [ Tuple field (Add (Constant delta)) ] | delta >= (-1) && delta <= 1 -> Just (Tuple field delta)
    _ -> Nothing
  let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
      recordName = recurrence.record <> "_loop"
      record = GoVar recordName
      previous = GoRecordFieldAccess record field
      value = if delta == 0 then previous else GoBinOp (if delta == 1 then "+" else "-") previous counter
      -- For all signed Int64 inputs this unsigned interval is exactly 1..top.
      -- Addition/subtraction modulo 2^64 followed by Int32 narrowing preserves
      -- the original low 32 bits, including noncanonical FFI field values.
      -- Even delta zero must narrow on n>0; n=0 takes the unchanged fallback.
      admitted = GoBinOp "<" (GoBinOp "-" (GoCall (GoVar "uint64") [ counter ]) (GoInt 1)) (GoInt top)
  pure (GoBlock
    [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoMutate (recordName <> "." <> recordFieldName field) (narrow value), GoReturn record ] []
    , GoReturn fallback
    ])

recognize :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Recurrence
recognize self params result body = do
  parameters <- case params of
    [ Tuple counter TypeInt64, Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _) ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: true }
    [ Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _), Tuple counter TypeInt64 ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: false }
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (parameters.counter /= parameters.record && result == parameters.ty)
  branch <- case syntax body of
    Syn.Branch branches step -> case NEA.toArray branches of
      [ Pair condition seed ] -> Just { condition, seed, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax branch.condition of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntOrd Syn.OpEq) left right) ->
      (local parameters.counter left && literal 0 right)
        || (literal 0 left && local parameters.counter right)
    _ -> false)
  guard (local parameters.record branch.seed)
  arguments <- case syntax branch.step of
    Syn.App target args | self target -> Just (NEA.toArray args)
    Syn.UncurriedApp target args | self target -> Just args
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple nextCounter nextRecord <- case arguments of
    [ first, second ] -> Just (if parameters.counterFirst then Tuple first second else Tuple second first)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax nextCounter of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) ->
      local parameters.counter left && literal 1 right
    _ -> false)
  changes <- recordChanges parameters.counter parameters.record [] parameters.ty nextRecord
  pure { counter: parameters.counter, record: parameters.record, changes }

-- Every updated leaf reads its own previous value. Cross-field dependencies,
-- calls, effects, duplicate updates and layout changes retain the original loop.
-- Unchanged fields are copied by value, including any borrowed references.
recordChanges :: String -> String -> Array String -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Change
recordChanges counter record path ty expression
  | recordPath record expression == Just path = Just Keep
  | otherwise = case ty, syntax expression of
      recordType@(TypeRecord fields), Syn.Update source props -> do
        guard (recordPath record source == Just path)
        let keys = map (\(Prop key _) -> key) props
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub keys) == Array.length keys)
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub (map fst fields)) == Array.length fields)
        updates <- traverse (\(Prop key value) -> do
          Tuple _ fieldType <- Array.find (\(Tuple label _) -> label == key) fields
          change <- recordChanges counter record (Array.snoc path key) fieldType value
          pure (Tuple key change)) props
        pure (Fields recordType updates)
      TypeInt64, Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right)
        | recordPath record left == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter right
        | recordPath record right == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter left
      _, _ -> Nothing

increment :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Delta
increment counter expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) | value >= bottom && value <= top -> Just (Constant value)
  Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMod) value divisor) | local counter value -> do
    modulus <- intLiteral divisor
    guard (modulus > 0 && modulus <= top)
    pure (Remainders modulus)
  _ -> Nothing

emit :: GoExpr -> GoExpr -> Change -> GoExpr
emit counter original = case _ of
  Keep -> original
  Fields ty fields -> GoRecordUpdateNative ty original
    (map (\(Tuple key change) -> Tuple key (emit counter (GoRecordFieldAccess original key) change)) fields)
  Add delta ->
    -- At least one IntAdd executes on the admitted path. Normalize its seed
    -- first, so even noncanonical Int64 FFI inputs need no overflow assumption.
    -- n and each literal fit Int32; products and their sum fit signed Int64.
    narrow (GoBinOp "+" (narrow original) (total counter delta))

total :: GoExpr -> Delta -> GoExpr
total count = case _ of
  Constant value -> GoBinOp "*" count (integer value)
  Remainders modulus ->
    let divisor = integer modulus
        quotient = GoBinOp "/" count divisor
        remainder = GoBinOp "%" count divisor
        cycles = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" (GoBinOp "*" quotient divisor) (integer (modulus - 1))) (integer 2)
        suffix = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" remainder (GoBinOp "+" remainder (integer 1))) (integer 2)
    -- Sum k mod d for k=1..n: complete periods plus the final 1..remainder.
    in GoBinOp "+" cycles suffix

syntax :: TcoExpr -> BackendSyntax TcoExpr
syntax (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Typed _ inner -> syntax inner
  Syn.TypeApp inner _ -> syntax inner
  _ -> value

local :: String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
local name expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level -> localId ident level == name
  _ -> false

recordPath :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe (Array String)
recordPath root expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level | localId ident level == root -> Just []
  Syn.Accessor source (Syn.GetProp key) -> map (flip Array.snoc key) (recordPath root source)
  _ -> Nothing

intLiteral :: TcoExpr -> Maybe Int
intLiteral expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) -> Just value
  _ -> Nothing

literal :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
literal value expression = intLiteral expression == Just value

narrow :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
narrow value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ value ] ]

integer :: Int -> GoExpr
integer value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt value ]

module Gopurs.CodeGen
  ( translate
  , translateWithFunctions
  , PreparedModule
  , prepareModule
  , workerInputs
  , workerOwners
  , globalTypeDemands
  , translatePreparedWithFunctions
  ) where

import Prelude
import Gopurs.Cache.LookupTable as LookupTable
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(PrimEffect, PrimOp, Branch, Fail, CtorDef, CtorSaturated, Lit, UncurriedAbs, Abs, Update, Accessor, LetRec, Let, EffectDefer, EffectPure, EffectBind, UncurriedEffectAbs, UncurriedEffectApp, UncurriedApp, App, Local, Var, Typed))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import Data.String as String
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..), Literal(..), Prop(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn as CoreFn
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoDecl(..), GoType(..), GoFile, capitalize, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated, foreignSymbol)
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoFile)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import Gopurs.ThunkFusion (optimizeThunkProducers)
import Gopurs.FunctionFusion (optimizeFunctionProducers)
import Gopurs.ListFusion as ListFusion
import Gopurs.ListProgressionFold as ListProgressionFold
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications (optimizeImmediateApplications)
import Gopurs.RegexMatchProjection as RegexMatchProjection
import Gopurs.Ownership as Ownership
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr, generateReboxFunctions)
import Gopurs.PrimitiveExprs as PrimitiveExprs
import Gopurs.RecordExprs as RecordExprs
import Gopurs.RecordReadGroups as RecordReadGroups
import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds as ClosedIndexedFolds
import Gopurs.CodePointFold as CodePointFold
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ConstructorExprs as ConstructorExprs
import Gopurs.LiteralExprs as LiteralExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics as ArrayIntrinsics
import Gopurs.ClosedDictionaries (cacheClosedDictionaries)
import Gopurs.ClosedScalar as ClosedScalar
import Gopurs.ConstructorFold as ConstructorFold
import Gopurs.BorrowedObjects (borrowReadOnlyObjects)
import Gopurs.RefLoopRegions as RefLoopRegions
import Gopurs.DecoderSchemas (specializeDecoderSchemas)
import Gopurs.CallExprs as CallExprs
import Gopurs.FunctionExprs as FunctionExprs
import Gopurs.BindingExprs as BindingExprs
import Gopurs.ControlExprs as ControlExprs
import Gopurs.EffectExprs as EffectExprs
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.ImmediateEffects as ImmediateEffects
import Gopurs.TypedExprs as TypedExprs
import Gopurs.RecordConsumer as RecordConsumer
import Gopurs.ModuleBindings as ModuleBindings
import Gopurs.ModuleDeclarations as ModuleDeclarations
import Gopurs.GoImports (collectImports)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, isEffectNode)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, childContext)

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata (CodePointFold.optimize (ClosedIndexedFolds.optimize inputMod)))
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize (RefLoopRegions.optimize progressions.module)
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    foldDescriptors = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      map (\(Tuple (Ident name) value) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (ClosedIndexedFolds.describe value)) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    codePointDescriptors = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      map (\(Tuple (Ident name) value) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (CodePointFold.describe value)) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    describedFunctions = Map.fromFoldable (map (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple name (info
      { arrayFold = if info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64 && info.arity == 1 then fromMaybe Nothing (Map.lookup name foldDescriptors) else Nothing
      , codePointFold = if info.fArgs == [ TypeString ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64 && info.arity == 1 then fromMaybe Nothing (Map.lookup name codePointDescriptors) else Nothing
      })) (Map.toUnfoldable preparedBindings.functions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo)))
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions describedFunctions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        proofs = RecordConsumer.prepare modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
        translator = if Map.isEmpty proofs then translateExpr else translateExprWith proofs
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translator metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups = map (map RecordReadGroups.declaration)
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr = translateExprWith Map.empty

translateExprWith :: RecordConsumer.Plans -> TranslateExpr
translateExprWith proofs context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    recur = translateExprWith proofs
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap recur context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated recur context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array recur context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record recur context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application recur context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction recur context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication recur context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction recur context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication recur context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction recur context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect recur context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue recur context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer recur context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          case RecordConsumer.emit proofs recur context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
            Just result -> result
            Nothing -> BindingExprs.nonRecursive recur context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive recur context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = recur child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = recur child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = recur child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated recur context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch recur context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = recur child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            recurOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      recurOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  recur (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = recurOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = recur child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd recur context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr recur context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex recur context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison recur context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct recur context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.guardedIntProduct recur context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.powerOfTwoModulo recur context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = recur child nextId e1
                res2 = recur child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive recur context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

-- Collapse pure countdown recurrences over immutable native records. The
-- complete update tree is proved before changing the number of iterations.
module Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops (wrap, hot, flatAdditive, additiveTotal) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), recordFieldName)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Literal(..), Prop(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

data Delta = Constant Int | Remainders Int
data Change = Keep | Fields GoType (Array (Tuple String Change)) | Add Delta

type Recurrence = { counter :: String, record :: String, changes :: Change }

wrap :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
wrap self params result body original = case recognize self params result body of
  Just recurrence ->
    let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
        record = GoVar (recurrence.record <> "_loop")
        admitted = GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp ">" counter (integer 0))
          (GoBinOp "<=" counter (integer top))
    in GoBlock [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoReturn (emit counter record recurrence.changes) ] [], original ]
  Nothing -> original

-- A small native wrapper can inline at its callers while the complete old
-- worker remains the cold fallback. Only one flat field and a cheap constant
-- delta are admitted; nested updates and larger expressions keep their layout.
-- The proof of the recurrence is shared with wrap, not reconstructed from Go.
hot :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
hot self params result body fallback = do
  recurrence <- recognize self params result body
  Tuple field delta <- case recurrence.changes of
    Fields _ [ Tuple field (Add (Constant delta)) ] | delta >= (-1) && delta <= 1 -> Just (Tuple field delta)
    _ -> Nothing
  let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
      recordName = recurrence.record <> "_loop"
      record = GoVar recordName
      previous = GoRecordFieldAccess record field
      value = if delta == 0 then previous else GoBinOp (if delta == 1 then "+" else "-") previous counter
      -- For all signed Int64 inputs this unsigned interval is exactly 1..top.
      -- Addition/subtraction modulo 2^64 followed by Int32 narrowing preserves
      -- the original low 32 bits, including noncanonical FFI field values.
      -- Even delta zero must narrow on n>0; n=0 takes the unchanged fallback.
      admitted = GoBinOp "<" (GoBinOp "-" (GoCall (GoVar "uint64") [ counter ]) (GoInt 1)) (GoInt top)
  pure (GoBlock
    [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoMutate (recordName <> "." <> recordFieldName field) (narrow value), GoReturn record ] []
    , GoReturn fallback
    ])

recognize :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Recurrence
recognize self params result body = do
  parameters <- case params of
    [ Tuple counter TypeInt64, Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _) ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: true }
    [ Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _), Tuple counter TypeInt64 ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: false }
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (parameters.counter /= parameters.record && result == parameters.ty)
  branch <- case syntax body of
    Syn.Branch branches step -> case NEA.toArray branches of
      [ Pair condition seed ] -> Just { condition, seed, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax branch.condition of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntOrd Syn.OpEq) left right) ->
      (local parameters.counter left && literal 0 right)
        || (literal 0 left && local parameters.counter right)
    _ -> false)
  guard (local parameters.record branch.seed)
  arguments <- case syntax branch.step of
    Syn.App target args | self target -> Just (NEA.toArray args)
    Syn.UncurriedApp target args | self target -> Just args
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple nextCounter nextRecord <- case arguments of
    [ first, second ] -> Just (if parameters.counterFirst then Tuple first second else Tuple second first)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax nextCounter of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) ->
      local parameters.counter left && literal 1 right
    _ -> false)
  changes <- recordChanges parameters.counter parameters.record [] parameters.ty nextRecord
  pure { counter: parameters.counter, record: parameters.record, changes }

-- Every updated leaf reads its own previous value. Cross-field dependencies,
-- calls, effects, duplicate updates and layout changes retain the original loop.
-- Unchanged fields are copied by value, including any borrowed references.
recordChanges :: String -> String -> Array String -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Change
recordChanges counter record path ty expression
  | recordPath record expression == Just path = Just Keep
  | otherwise = case ty, syntax expression of
      recordType@(TypeRecord fields), Syn.Update source props -> do
        guard (recordPath record source == Just path)
        let keys = map (\(Prop key _) -> key) props
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub keys) == Array.length keys)
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub (map fst fields)) == Array.length fields)
        updates <- traverse (\(Prop key value) -> do
          Tuple _ fieldType <- Array.find (\(Tuple label _) -> label == key) fields
          change <- recordChanges counter record (Array.snoc path key) fieldType value
          pure (Tuple key change)) props
        pure (Fields recordType updates)
      TypeInt64, Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right)
        | recordPath record left == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter right
        | recordPath record right == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter left
      _, _ -> Nothing

increment :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Delta
increment counter expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) | value >= bottom && value <= top -> Just (Constant value)
  Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMod) value divisor) | local counter value -> do
    modulus <- intLiteral divisor
    guard (modulus > 0 && modulus <= top)
    pure (Remainders modulus)
  _ -> Nothing

emit :: GoExpr -> GoExpr -> Change -> GoExpr
emit counter original = case _ of
  Keep -> original
  Fields ty fields -> GoRecordUpdateNative ty original
    (map (\(Tuple key change) -> Tuple key (emit counter (GoRecordFieldAccess original key) change)) fields)
  Add delta ->
    -- At least one IntAdd executes on the admitted path. Normalize its seed
    -- first, so even noncanonical Int64 FFI inputs need no overflow assumption.
    -- n and each literal fit Int32; products and their sum fit signed Int64.
    narrow (GoBinOp "+" (narrow original) (total counter delta))

total :: GoExpr -> Delta -> GoExpr
total count = case _ of
  Constant value -> GoBinOp "*" count (integer value)
  Remainders modulus ->
    let divisor = integer modulus
        quotient = GoBinOp "/" count divisor
        remainder = GoBinOp "%" count divisor
        cycles = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" (GoBinOp "*" quotient divisor) (integer (modulus - 1))) (integer 2)
        suffix = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" remainder (GoBinOp "+" remainder (integer 1))) (integer 2)
    -- Sum k mod d for k=1..n: complete periods plus the final 1..remainder.
    in GoBinOp "+" cycles suffix

syntax :: TcoExpr -> BackendSyntax TcoExpr
syntax (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Typed _ inner -> syntax inner
  Syn.TypeApp inner _ -> syntax inner
  _ -> value

local :: String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
local name expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level -> localId ident level == name
  _ -> false

recordPath :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe (Array String)
recordPath root expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level | localId ident level == root -> Just []
  Syn.Accessor source (Syn.GetProp key) -> map (flip Array.snoc key) (recordPath root source)
  _ -> Nothing

intLiteral :: TcoExpr -> Maybe Int
intLiteral expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) -> Just value
  _ -> Nothing

literal :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
literal value expression = intLiteral expression == Just value

narrow :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
narrow value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ value ] ]

integer :: Int -> GoExpr
integer value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt value ]

-- Ephemeral consumers reuse this complete recurrence proof. No imported ABI
-- or usage count establishes the meaning of an arbitrary record function.
flatAdditive :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe { keys :: Array String, deltas :: Array Int, counterFirst :: Boolean }
flatAdditive self params result body = do
  recurrence <- recognize self params result body
  fields <- case result of
    TypeRecord fields | Array.all (\(Tuple _ ty) -> ty == TypeInt64) fields -> Just fields
    _ -> Nothing
  changes <- case recurrence.changes of
    Fields _ changes | not (Array.null changes) -> Just changes
    _ -> Nothing
  deltas <- traverse (\(Tuple _ change) -> case change of
    Add (Constant delta) -> Just delta
    _ -> Nothing) changes
  pure { keys: map fst fields, deltas, counterFirst: case params of
    [ Tuple _ TypeInt64, _ ] -> true
    _ -> false }

additiveTotal :: GoExpr -> Array Int -> GoExpr
additiveTotal counter deltas = foldl (GoBinOp "+") (GoInt 0)
  (map (total counter <<< Constant) deltas)

-- A module-local proof, captured by the translator, never published as ABI.
module Gopurs.RecordConsumer (Plan, Plans, prepare, emit) where

import Prelude
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (foldl, all)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), snd)
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold (onlyCurried)
import Gopurs.BindingExprs as BindingExprs
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs)
import Gopurs.CodePointFold (compatibleT)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, ModuleFunctions, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops as RecordAffineLoops
import Gopurs.RecordShapeGuard as RecordShapeGuard
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Literal(..), Prop(..), Ident(..), ModuleName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..), BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendOperatorOrd(..), Level, Pair(..))

type Plan = { keys :: Array String, deltas :: Array Int, counterFirst :: Boolean, recordType :: ExprType }
type Plans = Map.Map String Plan

prepare :: String -> ModuleFunctions -> Array { recursive :: Boolean, bindings :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) } -> Plans
prepare owner functions groups = Map.fromFoldable (Array.mapMaybe describe groups)
  where
  describe group = do
    guard group.recursive
    Tuple (Ident rawName) value <- case group.bindings of
      [ binding ] -> Just binding
      _ -> Nothing
    let name = sanitizeName rawName
    info <- Map.lookup name functions
    guard (info.arity == 2 && Array.length info.fArgs == 2)
    abs <- extractUncurriedAbs value
    guard (Array.length abs.args == 2)
    signature <- extractFuncType value
    proof <- RecordAffineLoops.flatAdditive (AffineLoops.globalTarget owner name)
      (namedParameters abs.args info.fArgs) info.fRet abs.body
    recordType <- case signature.fArgs of
      [ Int, ty@(Record _) ] | proof.counterFirst -> Just ty
      [ ty@(Record _), Int ] | not proof.counterFirst -> Just ty
      _ -> Nothing
    guard (signature.fRet == recordType && validRecurrence owner name signature.fArgs recordType value)
    guard (not (Array.null proof.keys) && Array.length (Array.nub proof.keys) == Array.length proof.keys)
    pure (Tuple name { keys: proof.keys, deltas: proof.deltas, counterFirst: proof.counterFirst, recordType })

-- Require the complete additive observation, with no other use or intervening
-- computation. Inputs are existing locals: capture order and effects stay at
-- their original call sites. No usage annotation is treated as ownership.
emit :: Plans -> TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit plans translate context nextId ident level binding body = do
  guard (Array.null context.recVars && onlyCurried binding)
  let Tuple target segments = collectGoSpine binding
  name <- case unwrapTcoExpr target of
    Var (Qualified (Just (ModuleName _)) (Ident name))
      | AffineLoops.globalTarget context.modNameStr (sanitizeName name) target -> Just (sanitizeName name)
    _ -> Nothing
  plan <- Map.lookup name plans
  Tuple count input <- case getGoSpineArgs segments of
    [ first, second ] -> Just (if plan.counterFirst then Tuple first second else Tuple second first)
    _ -> Nothing
  inputId <- local input
  countId <- local count
  inputBound <- Map.lookup inputId context.bound
  countBound <- Map.lookup countId context.bound
  guard (inputBound.goType == TypeValue && (countBound.goType == TypeInt64 || countBound.goType == TypeValue))
  let args = if plan.counterFirst then [ Int, plan.recordType ] else [ plan.recordType, Int ]
  guard (compatibleT (Func args plan.recordType) target && compatibleT plan.recordType binding
    && compatibleT plan.recordType input && compatibleT Int count)
  scalar <- case unwrapTcoExpr body of
    EffectPure value | context.options.inEffectBlock && effectInt body -> Just value
    EffectPure _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Just body
  reads <- projections plan.recordType scalar
  let resultId = localId ident level
      updated = map snd (Array.filter (\(Tuple source _) -> source == resultId) reads)
      original = map snd (Array.filter (\(Tuple source _) -> source == inputId) reads)
      keys = Array.sort plan.keys
  guard (resultId /= inputId && Array.length reads == 2 * Array.length keys
    && Array.sort updated == keys && Array.sort original == keys)
  let
    -- The fallback is translated through the ordinary Let path, not this hook.
    fallback = BindingExprs.nonRecursive translate context nextId ident level binding body
    prefix = fresh ("recordConsumer_" <> show nextId) (map (\(Tuple _ value) -> value.name) (Map.toUnfoldable context.bound :: Array (Tuple String { name :: String, goType :: GoType })))
    record = prefix <> "_input"
    counter = if countBound.goType == TypeValue then GoSelector (GoVar countBound.name) "IntVal" else GoVar countBound.name
    fast values =
      let sum = foldl (GoBinOp "+") (GoInt 0) values
          subtotal = GoVar (prefix <> "_sum")
          total = GoBinOp "+" (GoBinOp "+" subtotal subtotal) (RecordAffineLoops.additiveTotal counter plan.deltas)
          result = "int64(int32(" <> printGoExpr total <> "))"
      in prefix <> "_sum := " <> printGoExpr sum <> "\nreturn " <> (if fallback.exprType == TypeValue then "gopurs_runtime.Int(" <> result <> ")" else result)
    admitted = GoBinOp "<" (GoBinOp "-" (GoCall (GoVar "uint64") [ counter ]) (GoInt 1)) (GoInt 2147483647)
    statements = [ GoAssign record (GoVar inputBound.name)
      , GoIfElse admitted [ rawGo (RecordShapeGuard.integerReads prefix record keys fast) ] []
      ] <> flattenStmts fallback.stmts <> [ GoReturn fallback.expr ]
  -- The proved primitive result is Int64 or its existing Value boxing. No
  -- admission check follows fallback translation, which may allocate IDs.
  pure { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoCall (GoFuncBlock [] statements fallback.exprType) [], exprType: fallback.exprType, nextId: fallback.nextId }

local :: TcoExpr -> Maybe String
local value = case unwrapTcoExpr value of
  Local ident level -> Just (localId ident level)
  _ -> Nothing

projections :: ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe (Array (Tuple String String))
projections recordType value = do
  guard (compatibleT Int value)
  case unwrapTcoExpr value of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpAdd) left right) -> (<>) <$> projections recordType left <*> projections recordType right
    Accessor source (GetProp key) -> do
      guard (compatibleT recordType source)
      name <- local source
      pure [ Tuple name key ]
    _ -> Nothing

fresh :: String -> Array String -> String
fresh prefix names = if Array.any (String.contains (Pattern prefix)) names
  then fresh (prefix <> "_") names else prefix

-- Recheck every annotation inside the proved recurrence. The structural loop
-- proof strips wrappers for matching, but wrappers cannot contradict its facts.
validRecurrence :: String -> String -> Array ExprType -> ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
validRecurrence owner name arguments recordType = lambdas Map.empty arguments
  where
  lambdas locals remaining value = compatibleT (Func remaining recordType) value && case unwrapTcoExpr value of
    Abs parameters body ->
      let params = NEA.toArray parameters
          count = Array.length params
          bound = Map.union (Map.fromFoldable (Array.zipWith (\(Tuple ident level) ty -> Tuple (localId ident level) ty) params (Array.take count remaining))) locals
          rest = Array.drop count remaining
      in count <= Array.length remaining && if Array.null rest then check bound recordType body else lambdas bound rest body
    _ -> false
  check locals expected value = compatibleT expected value && case unwrapTcoExpr value of
    Local ident level -> Map.lookup (localId ident level) locals == Just expected
    Lit (LitInt _) -> expected == Int
    Accessor source (GetProp _) -> expected == Int && check locals recordType source
    Update source props -> expected == recordType && check locals recordType source && all (\(Prop _ field) -> check locals Int field) props
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right) -> expected == Int && Array.elem operator [ OpAdd, OpSubtract ] && check locals Int left && check locals Int right
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpEq) left right) -> expected == Boolean && check locals Int left && check locals Int right
    Branch branches final -> check locals expected final && all (\(Pair condition branch) -> check locals Boolean condition && check locals expected branch) branches
    App function args -> expected == recordType && AffineLoops.globalTarget owner name function && compatibleT (Func arguments recordType) function
      && Array.length arguments == NEA.length args && all identity (Array.zipWith (check locals) arguments (NEA.toArray args))
    _ -> false

-- PBO keeps an inner Effect a annotation under the instantiated Effect Int.
-- Only this canonical constructor and an unconstrained scalar slot refine;
-- concrete contradictory effect payloads retain the ordinary path.
effectInt :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
effectInt (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed ty value -> valid ty && effectInt value
  Syn.TypeApp value _ -> effectInt value
  _ -> true
  where
  valid = case _ of
    Any -> true
    TypeVar _ -> true
    ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ Int ] -> true
    ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ Any ] -> true
    ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ TypeVar _ ] -> true
    _ -> false
